checks.check: Collector complete is the first actual metadata gate; public cohort files are read only after closure and independent-review PASS.
Fixed launcher, collector, independent-review source and plan constants match present source bytes.
Fixed head71aaa1c and plan16982554 must match closure/start/review provenance.
Closure requires audit/session/report stages and successful session/report; structured audit errors remain represented.
Independent review requires all checks passed, zero new experimental calls and matching collector hash.
Closed batch and stopped/absent owned-process attestations are required before plotting.
Two unique fixed run IDs, one known task and exact integer replication1/seed57 are required.
Public raw rows, material rows and CSV identities and fields must match.
Missing or audit-error slots retain null measurements rather than zeros.
Unknown usage makes exact total and nested exact input/output/cached totals null.
Row-derived all-policy-replication and comparison aggregates are independently recomputed.
Cheap failures, quality gain/loss and common success are separated in pair groups.
Gate requires both evaluated with known costs, both successful, lower total/common costs, actual on exposure and intact contracts.
Exposure cannot exceed captures; captures cannot exceed accepted installations; off exposure must be zero.
Captured packets without dispatched actor input do not count as exposure; missing/incomplete capture accounting uses NA/known subtotal.
Capture wall time stays separate from count panels and is bounded by task wall time; overlapping times are not stacked.
Official task success can coexist with a labeled contract stop.
Only public relative source paths and hashes are exported; no prompt/state/evaluator content or saved code execution.
New output directory is mandatory; synthetic mode cannot receive actual artifact paths.
One task/one seed/two conditions and lack of general quality, novelty or timing claim are explicit.

method: Source inspection of load_closed, validate_rows, aggregates/criteria and rendering branches, plus hash comparison of source constants. No actual loader or renderer invocation.
limitations: Visual readability of actual PNG/PDF must be checked after all closed gates.
The renderer trusts hash-bound closed review attestations for prior process absence and inventory records; it does not independently reconstruct live Python state.
This review does not treat audit/renderer consistency as method efficacy or novelty.
